move.reasoning: Start with the value of the single chipped mug ($24) while addressing the glaze variation fact.
move.message: Hi Priya, I am so sorry one of the mugs arrived chipped! Since it's a set of four, that one mug is valued at $24, and our listing does note that glazes naturally vary. We'd love to issue a $24 partial refund for the damaged piece so you can still enjoy the rest of the set. - Juniper & Kiln
